```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load functions/packages:
```{r}
source("sim_mean_sd.R")
library(tidyverse)
```
## Create a sim:
```{r}
output = vector("list", 1000)

for (i in 1:1000) {
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(30)
}

sim_results = bind_rows(output)
```

## Inspect Results:

```{r}
## Look at mean output:
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarize(
    emp_m = mean(mu_hat),
    emp_se = sd(mu_hat)
  )

## Plot outputs:
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mu_hat)) +
  geom_density()
```

## DO this using tibbles and map:

```{r}
sim_results_df = 
  tibble(
    sample_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(sample_size, sim_mean_sd)
    ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

## Look at results:
```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mu_hat)) +
  geom_density()
```


## Change `n`
```{r, chache = TRUE}
sim_results_df = 
 expand_grid(
   samp_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
   iter = 1:1000
 ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
    ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    samp_size = str_c("n = ", samp_size),
    samp_size = fct_inorder(samp_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = samp_size, y = mu_hat)) +
  geom_violin()
```
